title: REEL-QUEST: A Digital Platform for Exploration of Rare-Earth Extraction Ligands and Quantitative Understanding of Elemental Selectivity Trends
description:
A curated, structure-keyed database of liquid-liquid extraction distribution ratios for the lanthanides (La-Lu) plus Y and Sc, with per-measurement provenance (primary-paper DOI, figure/table locator, source compilation), a 21-subtype SMARTS taxonomy of extractants, per-ligand selectivity-trend classification across the lanthanide series with bootstrap confidence intervals, a Python API, a read-only REST API and an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

Code is released under the MIT licence (LICENSE); the database, vocabularies and schema under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Values reached the database from the Liu et al. 2022 JACS Au compilation, the SAFE database (Separation Archive for Elements), the OECD-NEA IDEaL database and Pramanik et al. 2024 JACS; each condition cites the paper that reported it.
notes: Code: MIT. Data (data/, vocab/, schema/): CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.
